I've split the PR-2 scope (gating swap, per-test JUnit budgets / AC4) into TASK-1988, so TASK-1957 = PR-1 and your (TASK-1957) trailer is now correct. Just update the PR body: say this is PR-1 and that the remaining scope is TASK-1988.
2 [fix]: scripts/ci-test-shards.py NEXTEST_PART_RE misses nextest's 'N exec failed' summary part, so totals() undercounts failures. Add exec failed (and check nextest's other summary words: leaky, flaky, retried) to the regex, and count exec-failed as failures. Add a unit test for the summary line from the finding. Check the rest of the findings file for anything else marked blocking.
Merge origin/main, gate (check-ci-fast + check-ci-compile), push, then mail me the SHA. This is the last round.
